instruction: Visit https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/searching and copy the content about user experience considerations into a Word document. Save it as "ux_considerations.docx" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires web navigation to Apple HIG and extracting UX content. Evaluator verifies document has minimum character count. Similar to original in web-to-document workflow.
